description: Creates a new composition from TSX source and opens it as a tab in the user's Motion page. `files` maps path to source and must include the entry (default composition.tsx). The API is specific to Motion and documented in read_skill {topic:'motion'}; design guidance is in {topic:'motion-craft'}. A partsBoard prop (default false) can lay out UI-like parts for checking before scenes are built.

schema.description: Props schema; drives the editable controls.

token.description: The session token that connect returned.
